brief.scope: Map the reviewed lane-policy contract plus final-ruling corrections to the smallest testable implementation sequence. No new architecture. Specify exact public CLI/API inputs for trusted anchor, profile and maintenance receipt, their owning existing tools and first behavioral tests using real current seams with fake vendors/fixture stores. Avoid missing-import/collection-error reds or invented permissive stand-ins. Identify only the first ready 1-3-file bucket and its independent test/skeptic/code commands; explain how partial work remains inert until the minimum complete activation boundary. Keep all settle/resume/collect/land/ladder checks, bootstrap custody and ordinary authorized maintenance. D-LANES-1 is semantic evidence, not policy admission. No C2 output ownership, new executor or Symfony dependency. Return compact inline PLAN with precise interface/test-readiness gaps if any. Read-only: no source/tests/settings/host/DB/network edits or vendor launches.

Receipt serialization, dependency-evidence serialization and result.policy field names also remain insufficiently exact for complete integration fixtures. These are interface-readiness gaps, not grounds for replacing the architecture.

PLAN — measured against 2ecf00e8de4c609b0b5bfd613e82d71ac7c2c9d7, base c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc.

Required contract correction: apply the supplied final ruling only to ops/conductor/lane-policy.md and ops/lane-policy.json: protect the two omitted entrypoints; require a fresh ratified admission and previously trusted verification for standing-set rotation; pair superseded-grant refusal with post-rotation success; pair note-induced existing-binding refusal with fresh-dispatch success without another owner act. D-LANES-1 remains semantic evidence, never blob admission, maintenance authorization or activation.

Public inputs to freeze before integration tests (PROPOSED additions, not current flags): dispatch.sh --trusted-anchor ABSOLUTE_FILE --profile ID [--maintenance-receipt ABSOLUTE_FILE], forwarded unchanged by ops/conductor/tools/dispatch.sh into launch.py's _launch_parser/_launch as args.trusted_anchor, args.profile and args.maintenance_receipt. No authority/profile environment variables or lane.conf keys. The trusted-anchor file is retained bootstrap custody evidence, not another policy registry: prescribe exact keys owner, host_home, repository, admission, consumer_ref, reader, reader_checkout, python, runtime_manifest; reader retains exactly ref/runtime_sha256. Paths are canonical absolute paths and refs/digests retain the contract's formats. The locator alone confers no trust: the admitted invoking consumer and host custody establish it; candidate/worktree copies cannot substitute. Policy remains the fixed Git blob ops/lane-policy.json.

Profile is a nonempty configured ID; absence permits only the admitted default, while explicit empty/unknown/conflicting selections refuse. Keep any structured declaration with its launch/task owner; do not introduce a jobs schema here. Maintenance-receipt transport should have exactly dispatch, job, lineage, standing and per_job: lineage has branch/base_sha; the two lists contain sorted unique record/sha256 pairs matching brief.policy. This is conductor-derived evidence, independently recomputed from live admitted show output, not authorization supplied by the file. Standing coverage needs no fresh owner decision. Omitted receipt must never suppress standing-grant discovery. For later transitions, propose --trusted-anchor on launch.py resume/close/collect, land.py and ladder start/resume; reuse the bound profile and receipt, with no replacement flags. Onboard may display the selected admitted summary through the same loader; it cannot activate policy.

Exact remaining input gap: per-job receipt production needs an agreed handoff of launch.mint_id(stage, harness) before attempt/filesystem mutation. No current public reservation or caller-ID argument exists. Do not accept wildcard IDs, let a receipt silently choose the ID, or use wrapper --dry-run as reservation. Contract that handoff before enabling per-job CLI success. Also freeze normalized declaration/dependency/result-policy byte schemas and the verified reader runtime closure. Launch/task owns output and adapter declarations; C2 is not transferred into this work. Missing grants remain empty, unavailable dependency analysis remains unavailable. These gaps block complete activation, not the bucket below.

FIRST READY EXECUTABLE BUCKET — exactly two files: ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/test_record.py (independent test producer) and ops/devlane/dispatch/record.py (different implementation producer). Implement only structural validation of optional brief.policy through the existing record.build(payload) and record.validate(rec, *, expected_id=None, expected_snapshot=None) APIs. Validate required binding fields, schema/path, Git IDs, digests, profile syntax, admission ID, template digest equality and the exact maintenance container/list shapes. Accept a syntactically valid synthetic profile without hardcoding membership. Preserve absent-policy legacy records and all existing identity/result checks; structural validity conveys no admission.

First behavioral tests use the existing _RecordCase._minimum fixture and load the real module with support.load('record'), never require_module's absent/echo fallback. Assert RecordError naming brief.policy for string/null/empty bindings, malformed digests, template mismatch and malformed/duplicate/unsorted maintenance entries. Positive neighbors cover a complete binding, null maintenance, synthetic profile and unchanged legacy bytes. An in-memory probe on this ref confirmed record.build currently accepts string, null and empty-object brief.policy: the red is a missing behavioral refusal, not an import or collection error. Do not import the absent lane_policy.py, catch AttributeError as success, add skips, or construct an allow-all evaluator.

Independent commands, for subsequent authorized execution only: test producer runs python3 -B -m unittest discover -s ops/devlane/dispatch/tests -p test_record.py and records named assertion failures with zero errors; skeptic reruns that command and checks clean neighbors and planted malformed bindings; implementation producer runs the identical command to green, then bash ops/bin/suites.sh. Dispatch each producer through the existing lever: bash ops/bin/dispatch.sh --worktree "$WT" --job author-tests --harness codex --model "$TEST_MODEL" --stage tests --scope-file "$TEST_SCOPE"; bash ops/bin/dispatch.sh --worktree "$WT" --job check-tests --harness claude --model "$SKEPTIC_MODEL" --stage check-tests --scope-file "$CONTRACT_SCOPE" --input "$WT/ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/test_record.py"; bash ops/bin/dispatch.sh --worktree "$WT" --job implement --harness codex --model "$CODE_MODEL" --stage code --scope-file "$COMMAND_SCOPE". The conductor supplies explicit independent producer selections and bounded scope files, advances reviewed snapshots through existing custody/land checks, and supplies the test command verbatim in COMMAND_SCOPE. No producer authors or approves its own tests; no vendor is launched by this review.

After that bucket, proceed in dependency order without declaring further buckets ready: freeze the interfaces above; implement the already-contracted stdlib evaluator/reader against real decisions.py fixtures; connect trusted preflight and binding; then connect every acceptance transition before cutover. Fixture authority uses the existing decisions.py add ID QUESTION --home ops/lane-policy.json, ratify ID --evidence 'PRINCIPAL: JSON', show ID, note ID TEXT and supersede ID --by SUCCESSOR --evidence EVIDENCE under temporary HOME. Stage the actual reader, laneconf and pinned configuration together; prohibit fallback imports. Do not reuse test_decisions_register's fixture unchanged: it snapshots the live store and permits an absent-tool stand-in. No live store read belongs in these new fixtures.

Integration tests use launch_support._TempLaunch/argv_for/dispatch, the existing fake CLI start witness and synthetic stores.py data, plus real temporary Git repositories. Test profile refusal before child/attempt creation; dev/prod/synthetic positive and negative paths; ordinary hooks/tooling with application/vendor absent; additive inspection reads; maintenance false despite valid evidence; repeated standing-authorized jobs; mixed standing/per-job coverage; rotation and note cases; candidate reader/config/seed substitution. Exercise actual _residual_entries for ignored/untracked/committed writes, binary paths, deletions, rename/copy endpoints and symlink escapes, retaining only existing cache exemptions. Assert new lane-* refusals as exit 2, empty stdout and expected/found/needed; the older generic launch assertion expects exit 3 and is unsuitable.

Activation remains indivisible: prelaunch authority/grants/dependencies; record binding and launcher result evidence; _settle before automatic commit/ref publication; _resume before caps/markers/stores/attempt changes and full settlement afterward; _collect before verification and again after verification before commit/ref/collected-marker changes; land.preconditions against the exact accepted/fetched head; ladder.Driver.load_envelope and stage advancement independently. Extend test_launch_collect, test_land_lever, test_ladder_lever and test_onboard_lever with real seams and fake external tools. Successful verdicts, exit 0 and collection never bypass policy or existing lineage, custody, attribution, freshness and ladder checks. Preserve suite, laneconf closure/literal and instrument-conformance gates; register new CLI refusal surfaces with their consumers.

Partial work is inert: optional record validation and uncalled library code neither select authority nor widen permissions. Keep the policy standing proposal; add no activation environment switch. Bootstrap development proceeds under existing explicit authorization, honestly unbound. Cutover requires independent verification and owner admission of the complete consumer/policy/reader-runtime custody boundary, verified ordinary maintenance support, and exclusion of old acceptance callers. Legacy records remain readable and unchanged but cannot write-resume, collect for acceptance, land or advance; continuation is a fresh bound dispatch retaining provenance. Runtime/profile limits remain acceptance detection unless adapter prevention is separately measured. No C2 output ownership, new executor, Symfony dependency or stronger containment claim.
